rows.text: The key to piloting Clive, Ifrit's Dominant is understanding its core engine: Clive discards your hand to draw cards equal to your devotion to red on entry, then transforms into Ifrit, Warden of Inferno to fight creatures and generate 8 red mana over two lore chapters before resetting to draw a fresh hand.

This is a Bracket 3 build running three Game Changers: Jeska's Will, The One Ring, Underworld Breach. It contains zero mass land denial and focuses on high-synergy board development, interactive answers, and an inevitable endgame clock.
